description: Design and size a cable (power, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre) from a sentence (any site language, e.g. "3-core collective screen 12/20 kV 3x95/25 Al, longitudinally watertight") or a spec: every layer's thickness with its source (IEC 60502, HD 603 / 620, BS, EN 50525, NEC / UL and more; IEC 60228), the overall diameter, the designation and the decoder's reading of it, and the estimated weight, bending radius, pulling force, IEC 60757 colours and MV field stress with their sources; current, voltage drop and short-circuit ratings; a bare designation works as the sentence; optional XML, DXF, SVG, CSV, GLB, STEP (3D CAD) and a PDF datasheet. Deterministic, no LLM; a nominal calculation, not a datasheet.

cpc.description: For cpc: {kind armour | core | separate | conduit (a steel conduit or trunking) | bare (a bare conductor) (default the armour where the design has one), basis iec | bs, column tp70 | tp90 | ts90, section_mm2 (required for conduit and bare), metal Cu | Al (separate) or Cu | Al | steel (bare), condition visible | normal | fire (bare: Table 54.6 / A.54.6), system TN | TT | IT (IT: a second fault, 411.6.4), circuit final | distribution, current ac | dc (Table 41.1's d.c. columns), u0_v (line to earth, default 230), ia_a (the current that operates the device in time), or device (a BS 7671 fuse bs88-2 | bs88-3 | bs3036 | bs1362, or a circuit-breaker type B | C | D) with device_a (its rating: the Tables 41.2 to 41.4 Zs at U0 230 V), length_m (the route length: the cable's own R1 + R2 at its operating temperature against the largest Zs)}.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of an earlier answer, changed.

fault.description: For cpc: {ka (the fault current), seconds (default fault_s)}: the adiabatic check of the armour or protective conductor (IEC 60364-5-54:2011 Annex A, BS 7671 Tables 54.2 to 54.6) up to 1 kV.

formats.description: Files to include: xml, dxf, svg, csv, glb (base64), step (STEP AP214 text), pdf (datasheet, base64).

installation.description: For ratings.current: how the cable is installed; the designer's defaults for what is not given (buried 0.8 m, 20 °C ground, 1.5 K·m/W, trefoil, alone). At 0.6/1 kV group, arrangement, clearance, trays and h3_pct give the IEC 60364-5-52 B.52.17 to B.52.21 (BS 7671 4C1 to 4C5) grouping and the E.52.1 harmonic factors; reel_drum puts a flexible cable on a reeling drum (NFPA 79 Table 12.7.3); restrained (buried or clamped) is read by ratings.short_circuit. The answer lists the defaults used and the fields the cable's table does not read.

air_formation.description: 0.6/1 kV single-core cables in free air: method F with 3 loaded, trefoil (default) or flat (touching); method G, horizontal (default) or vertical.

arrangement.description: 0.6/1 kV in air: how the group lies (bunched, on a wall or ceiling, on perforated, vertical or unperforated trays, on ladders, spaced); default bunched.

au_method.description: rating_basis au (AS/NZS 3008.1.1:2025 Tables 3.5 to 3.8): air (default), spaced, trefoil, conduit, buried or duct, the ones the design's cores take; buried and duct read ground_c (default 25), depth_m (default 0.5) and soil_k_m_per_w (default 1.2), the others air_c (default 40).

circuit_use.description: 0.6/1 kV, IEC 60364-5-52 Table 52.2: power (default), signal or electronic, which sets the smallest conductor (minimum in the answer when the design is below it).

clearance.description: 0.6/1 kV: touching (default), oneDiameter (multicore cables on an IEC tray), or the clearance in the ground between cables or ducts, m (0.125 to 1.0).

cord_carrying.description: A North American flexible cord (NFPA 79 2024 Table 12.8.2 at 30 °C): 3 current-carrying conductors (column A, default) or 2 (column B); a cord of two conductors is always column B.

h3_pct.description: 0.6/1 kV 4- and 5-core cables: the third-harmonic share of the phase current, % (IEC 60364-5-52 Table E.52.1).

iec_method.description: IEC 60364-5-52 reference method, 0.6/1 kV IEC basis (Table B.52.1): A1 / B1 single-core in conduit, A2 / B2 multicore in conduit, C on a wall, D1 in ducts, D2 direct in the ground, E / F in free air, G single-core spaced one diameter in free air.

is_circuit.description: rating_basis is3961, IS 1554-1 and IS 7098-1 (IS 3961 Parts 2 and 6), as the rating panel: three (a.c. three-phase, three single-core cables; default), single (a.c. single-phase: a single-core cable as one of two, a two-core cable itself) or dc (two single-core cables or one two-core cable; Part 2 Tables 9 to 12, Part 6 Tables 5 and 6). A single-core cable takes all three, a two-core cable single (its default) or dc, three to five cores three only; a circuit the cable does not take falls back to its first.

is_method.description: IS 694 on IS 3961 (Part 5): clipped (default), enclosed (in conduit or trunking), defined (the defined conditions) or trefoil (single-core, three-phase only).

is_pvc.description: rating_basis is3961, IS 1554-1 only: the PVC of cl. 4.1, A (general purpose, 70 °C, default) or C (heat resisting, 85 °C: IS 3961 Part 2 cl. 2 a, the 85 °C tables).

lead_alloy.description: ratings.short_circuit: yes when the lead sheath is a lead alloy (IEC 60986:2000+A1:2008 Table 3: 210 °C, lead 170 °C).

loaded.description: 0.6/1 kV single-core cables (not method G): a single-phase circuit, 2 loaded conductors, or three-phase, 3 (default); a two-core cable is always 2.

loaded_cores.description: An HD 603 cable of more than four cores: the loaded cores (DIN VDE 0276-1000 Table 13); default 3.

mv_install.description: Type MV and URD (NFPA 70 2026, 315.60 Tables (C)(1) to (C)(20)): airIsolated, airTriplexed, conduitAir, duct (default), buried or buriedTriplexed; the tables the construction has. group picks the circuits of the table (duct 1, 3 or 6; buried 1 or 2); air_c (default 40) or ground_c (default 20) the ambient.

mv_temp_c.description: Type MV and URD: the 90 °C (MV-90) or 105 °C (MV-105) column; default 90 for URD, 105 for MV-105.

phase.description: IS 694 single-core on IS 3961 (Part 5): a single-phase (2 cables) or three-phase (3 or 4 cables, default) circuit.

protection.description: IS 694 on IS 3961 (Part 5): close (default) or coarse excess current protection, which picks the Table 8 ambient row.

rating_basis.description: A 0.6/1 kV IEC design (not HD 603): iec (default, IEC 60364-5-52:2009), de (DIN VDE 0298-4:2013-06, the German tables of the same methods, its one differing cell named in override; no D2) or au (AS/NZS 3008.1.1:2025 with au_method; PVC not rated). An HD 620 S3:2023 Section 10-C design: iec (default, IEC 60502-2 Annex B with its factors) or hd620, the section's own Tables 7 to 10 (laying buried or air, formation for single cores: trefoil, or flat for flatTouching and flatSpaced) at the conditions of its clause 5 only (0.7 m, ground 20 °C, soil 1.0 / 2.5 K·m/W, load factor 0.7 in the earth; air 30 °C, load factor 1.0), since the section gives no conversion factors; no table for ducts. An Indian design (IS 1554-1, IS 7098-1, IS 7098-2, IS 694): iec (default, the IEC tables as for any design) or is3961. IS 1554-1 / IS 7098: the IS 3961 Part 2, 6 or 7 tables with their ambient, depth and soil factors (laying, formation, air_c default 40, ground_c default 30, depth_m default the depth of the part, soil_k_m_per_w default 1.5) and their group tables (group: circuits or multicore cables, one alone by default; in the ground or a duct spacing_mm, the clear distance between them, 0 touching, and tiers for multicore cables laid direct, Part 2 / 6 only; in air support tray (perforated), vertical or ladder, trays, and clearance oneDiameter for spaced multicore cables, else touching). IS 694: IS 3961 (Part 5) with is_method, phase (single-core), protection, air_c (default 40) and group (the circuits, cl. 4.2); flexible cables and cords take Table 5 with air_c and group only.

reel_drum.description: A flexible cable (class 5 or 6, or a cord) on a motor-driven reeling drum, as the rating panel: cylindrical (ventilated, wide flanges), radial-vent or radial-closed (spiral). amps becomes the rating on the drum, times the NFPA 79 (2024) Table 12.7.3 factor, whole amperes down; reel gives the factor, the DIN VDE 0298-4:2013-06 Table 27 factor beside it and the drum rules of 13.4.3.2.

reel_layers.description: With reel_drum cylindrical: the layers wound, 1 to 5 (Table 12.7.3 gives factors for 1 to 4; DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 27 for 1 to 5). Default 1.

restrained.description: ratings.short_circuit: yes when the cable is buried directly, clamped or bent tighter than specified (IEC 60986 3.2.2, IS 16269 3.2.2): a thermoplastic insulation's (PVC, PE) short-circuit limits are taken 10 °C lower. Default no.

strip_mm.description: ratings.short_circuit: an interlocked armour's strip thickness, mm (no maker prints it; without it the layer is listed in unrated).

tiers.description: IS 3961 (Part 2 / 6) Table 27 / 21: multicore cables laid direct in the ground in tiers (rating_basis is3961, group above 1).

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages for the answer's words (the sentence itself is read in any of them).

load.description: For voltage_drop and sizing: {length_m (required), amps or kw (default the design's own rating), phases 1 | 3, volts, pf (0.85), temp_c (the insulation's normal temperature), hz, limit_pct (a Table G.52.1 row 3, 5, 6, 8 raised beyond 100 m, or an own limit; default 5), conduit pvc | al | steel (NEC wires, Chapter 9 Table 9), formation touching | flat | spaced (single-core cables)}. IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G with the IEC 60287-1-1 a.c. resistance, BS 7671 Tables 4E4B, 4D4B, 4E3B, 4D3B or NEC Chapter 9 Table 9, and the smallest size by current, by drop and by both.

nec.description: North American wires: {ocpd_a (the overcurrent device; default from the ampacity), phase_min (250.122(B): the size before upsizing), install raceway | air | messenger (Table 310.20, single THHN, XHHW-2, USE-2, THW-2) | annexB (informative Annex B Table B.2(3), MC, MC-HL, TC, UF-B of 2 or 3 conductors in free air), ambient_c, carrying, termination_c 60 | 75 | 90}: nec.ampacity (NEC 310.16, 310.17, 310.20 or Table B.2(3)) and nec.egc (Table 250.122). A CSA design (T90, RW90, NMD90, AC90, TECK90): install, ambient_c, carrying and termination_c set ratings.current by CSA C22.1:24 Tables 1 to 4, 5A, 5C and 19.

sentence.description: The cable in words, any of the 15 site languages: voltage, cores, section, conductor metal, screen, sheath, watertightness, armour. What is not said takes a default, and the answer lists which.

spec.description: Instead of a sentence: {voltage: "12/20", cores: 3, section: 95, metal, screen, screenType, screenSection, screenLay (helical | interstices), insulation, sheath, watertight, armour}; add standard (an id from design_presets: HD620-10C, BS6724, UL-NMB, EN50525-2-21 ...) for that family's own build at the nearest voltage, size and count it lists; with an HD 620 section that lays three single cores up (HD620-10E1, -10E2, -10I1, -10I2, -10I3 ...), bundle none | messenger | earth and cores 3 builds the bundle; with IS9968-1, is9968 {kind, grade, ecc} picks the table and grade (ecc true: a flat twin with its bare ECC); with GOST1508, gostMark the mark. A LAN cable instead: {lan: {category cat5e ... cat8.2, shield, awg, and workArea (IEC 61156-6), cord (IEC 61156-8 / -10) or riser (25 pairs, IEC 61156-4) where the category is built so}, sheath PVC | LSZH}.

test_variant.description: For after_installation: a national variant of the tests after installation (HD620-10A, HD620-10C, HD620-10J, HD620-10M, HD620-10R, BS6622, IS1255, BS7846, BS5467, HD603-3F, HD603-G); default the one the design's standard implies.

name: design_cable
title: Design and size a power cable
